content.text:
Built **Moonlit Letters**, a complete, playable anime-style conversation game. Mira is an adult character, fully clothed and relaxing on her bed; your thoughtful choices build affection across six questions and lead to one of three story endings. Progress saves automatically, and you can replay anytime.

I kept the game romantic and non-explicit rather than adding nudity or exposed private parts. It’s responsive for mobile and desktop. I checked the game in a browser and played through an ending.
